policy.authority: The mission controller selects line identity and timing from authoritative state. Audio duration may delay later audio, never mission progression.
policy.epistemic: No surviving sortie transcript is registered. Every spoken line in this draft is procedural reconstruction, not a quotation.
policy.historicalPersons: Use original disclosed synthetic performances. Do not clone, match or request resemblance to Neil Armstrong, John Carpenter or any real recording.
policy.captions: Canonical captions exist independently of generated audio and remain available when audio is missing.
policy.generation: Generation remains blocked until source, phraseology, script, rights and performance-direction review.

speakers.performanceDirection: Young adult military pilot; contained, technically attentive and breathing under workload. Neutral Midwestern American speech without impersonation, celebrity resemblance or Apollo-era cadence.

speakers.role: flight lead and USAF exchange officer
speakers.performanceDirection: Mature operational pilot; concise, observant and unshowy. Distinct from Armstrong through pace and register, not a theatrical accent or imitation.

lines.function: Assign the player a readable formation station without exposition.
lines.reconstructionBasis: The exact formation and words are unknown; the line encodes the documented lead-wingman relationship.

observerFacts: Carpenter is established as lead.
The player is airborne and not yet inside the join envelope.

lines.function: Acknowledge the formation assignment with minimal radio load.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Position acknowledgement; exact call signs and wording require period phraseology review.

observerFacts: The player is converging on the assigned formation station.

lines.function: Mark the workload transition from coast transit to low-level ingress.
lines.reconstructionBasis: The target region and low-altitude work are supported; the exact route and call are not.

observerFacts: Carpenter has begun the authored descent.
The player remains within recoverable formation range.

lines.function: Provide the operational timing cue for the required attack run.
lines.reconstructionBasis: A restrained attack-position call; exact formation, target, ordnance and wording remain source-blocked.

observerFacts: Carpenter has entered the authored employment path.

lines.function: Commit the player to the required task and route.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Generic position call pending Korean War naval aviation phraseology review.

observerFacts: The player has entered the attack gate with the validated target selected.

lines.text: Lead, Two. I hit a cable. Right wing's damaged.
lines.performanceText: Lead, Two—I hit a cable; right wing's damaged.
lines.function: Name the event only after the player has recovered enough capacity to transmit.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Armstrong later described the cable and right-wing loss; this is not presented as his historical radio wording.

observerFacts: The player remains conscious.
Roll rate has fallen below the do-not-interrupt threshold.
The radio remains operable.

lines.text: Climb if you can. I'm coming across.
lines.function: Convert the lead from route authority to external inspection support.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Carpenter's continued presence and joint assessment are supported; the exact call is not.

observerFacts: Carpenter has a safe path toward the inspection station.

lines.function: Tell the player that stable formation, not another maneuver, is the current task.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Inspection geometry is reconstructed from operational necessity.

observerFacts: Carpenter has reached the outer inspection gate.

lines.function: Give Armstrong only the damage facts another pilot could visibly assess.
lines.reconstructionBasis: The substantial outer right-wing loss is source-supported; Carpenter's exact observation and words are not.

observerFacts: The detached outer right-wing geometry is visible from Carpenter's current station.

lines.text: It takes nearly all the stick to hold it. If I slow down, it'll go.
lines.function: Express the no-landing decision through player-demonstrated control margin.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Armstrong later explained the low-speed snap risk; wording and degree of stick demand are bound to simulation evidence, not historical quotation.

observerFacts: The player's sustained lateral input exceeds the authored high-demand threshold.
The damaged-aircraft model reports insufficient low-speed control margin for the landing envelope.

lines.text: Then we don't land it. Head south. I'll stay with you.
lines.function: Commit the documented decision and turn the next task into reaching friendly territory.
lines.reconstructionBasis: The joint no-landing decision and southbound flight are supported; the line is newly written.

observerFacts: Inspection is complete.
The no-landing decision predicate is authoritative.

lines.function: Make the historical boundary legible without turning the flight into chatter.
lines.reconstructionBasis: Armstrong recalled taking the aircraft south into friendly territory; exact route calls are unknown.

observerFacts: The player is within the final authored distance to the friendly-territory gate.

lines.text: Point it clear. Keep the speed.
lines.function: Prioritize disposal alignment and the damaged aircraft's control margin.
lines.reconstructionBasis: The exact disposal heading, ejection procedure and words remain handbook- and route-blocked.

observerFacts: The player has entered the ejection-area checkpoint.

lines.function: Mark the irreversible transition with the fewest possible words.
lines.reconstructionBasis: No incident radio transcript is registered.

observerFacts: Every exposed ejection preparation action is complete.
The aircraft remains inside the validated ejection envelope.

lines.function: Acknowledge without adding prophecy, sentiment or instruction after the decision.
lines.reconstructionBasis: No incident radio transcript is registered.

observerFacts: Carpenter remains in radio range.

evaluationCriteria: Intelligibility through the period radio treatment.
Composure that still exposes workload and breath.
No resemblance to a known recording or celebrity performance.
Stable pronunciation of Panther, Pohang and K-3 after phraseology lock.
Reproducible model snapshot, prompt, voice ID, take ID, file hash and loudness.
